hack.root_cause: ETH Bifrost override loop — msg.value spoofing via wrapped router
hack.description: THORChain's ETH Bifrost bridge lost $5M when an attacker wrapped the router contract to spoof a deposit amount of 200 against a real deposit of 0, exploiting an override loop the code's own comments warned should be restricted.
